narrative.overview: Neutral black and gray materials, off-white typography and primary lime actions extend the accepted trajectory hero into the shared conversational career workspace. Companion is dark neutral; closing is light neutral; footer handwriting uses original off-white SVG pen strokes with a lime dot. Fictional sample journeys stay visibly separate from native personal records and explicit model requests.
keyCharacteristics: Geist interface with Arial resumes and Georgia letters
Neutral border-separated conversation and contextual inspector
Dark neutral companion and light neutral closing band
Compact 660px phone with a notification-focused first state, seven sample states, visible-only four-stage autoplay and manual/pause controls
Licensed semantic activity table with local filters and details
Six scroll-linked chapters: discovery, requirements, resume, supporting material, review/apply and updates
First-party brand marks and documented illustrative stock photos
Ten-stroke original handwritten SVG footer, 3.9-second drawing, pointer replay and static reduced motion
Explicit sample provenance and execution boundaries
Three desktop OS selector cards with source ZIP/build instructions and explicit unpublished installer/mobile release states
Labeled semantic status badges: green ready/completed, amber review/unknown, red exclusion; no colored panels
Black main workspace, #070707 sidebar and #080808 inspector; simulated demo sourcing and truthful unconnected personal mode
Direct Product link, live outlined GitHub-count pill with unavailable em dash and 700px mobile hiding
Four simulated company watchers: PostHog, Stripe, Linear and Cloudflare; first-party marks
Pexels 8463168 professional introduction portrait with documented provenance
Six chapter controls meet 44px minimum targets; refreshed actual shared-workspace harness capture
dos: Preserve the accepted hero and trajectory geometry.
Retain reduced-motion and shader failure fallbacks.
Keep the retained light web dashboard separately scoped.
donts: Do not represent sample counts or completion states as real submissions.
Do not infer connected desktop Gmail or companion execution from preview UI.
Do not restore superseded green/blue panel tints or broad lime companion/closing bands.
